typography.guidelines: Banned: Inter, Roboto. Use IBM Plex Mono for headings and data labels to establish a technical, SOC-analyst aesthetic. Apply tracking-tight to headings and tracking-[0.2em] to overlines.

accents.process_standard: Matrix Green or Slate (text-emerald-400 or text-slate-300)

colors.guidelines: Force Dark Mode globally. Never use pure white backgrounds. Tint neutral greys with blue (slate). Use high contrast for text. Ensure APCA compliance.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders and Terminal Look. Use 1px solid borders (border-border/40) for panels. Remove soft shadows. Use backdrop-blur for floating elements. Never use transparent backgrounds on elements that overlap content.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle scanlines or grid backgrounds (React Flow Background variant='dots' or 'lines') for the canvas to simulate a technical terminal.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm max 2px). The UI should feel rigid, precise, and objective.

layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (For Dashboards/Analytics). Every pixel utilized.

structure.app_container: h-screen w-screen flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-background text-foreground
structure.header: h-14 border-b border-border/40 flex items-center px-4 justify-between bg-background/95 backdrop-blur-xl z-50 shrink-0
structure.inspector_panel: w-[400px] border-l border-border/40 bg-background/95 backdrop-blur shrink-0 overflow-y-auto flex flex-col p-4 gap-6

react_flow_nodes.style: Rectangular, rigid, 1px border. Background should be solid deep grey/black (bg-neutral-900). Border color indicates entity type (Red=Malware, Cyan=Network). Add a left border accent (4px thick) to denote type visually. DO NOT use generic rounded cards.
react_flow_nodes.typography: Process name in text-sm font-bold, PID in text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground.

inspector_panel.style: Dense key-value pairs. Key uses overline typography. Value uses monospace or standard body.
inspector_panel.spacing: gap-4 for sections, flex col gap-1 for key-value groups.

search_bar.style: Use Shadcn Input. Customization: bg-neutral-900 border-border/40 focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-cyan-500 rounded-none. Add search icon (Phosphor/Lucide).

badges.style: Sharp corners, 1px border, transparent background or 10% opacity of accent color. E.g., MITRE ATT&CK tags.

motion.guidelines: Minimalist. Use micro-interactions for feedback. Hover states on interactive elements should be crisp (e.g., background color change, text color change). React Flow nodes can have a subtle scale on hover or click.
motion.transitions: Do NOT use `transition-all`. Use explicit `transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out` or `transition-transform`.

accessibility.guidelines: Ensure high contrast for text over dark backgrounds. Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='search-input', data-testid='node-explorer-exe'). Support prefers-reduced-motion.

media.icons_library: lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react. Recommend sharp, technical icons.

3d_libraries.usage: Not recommended for this specific MVP, stick to React Flow and Dagre for 2D process graphs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Force Dark Mode in tailwind and index.css.
Use React Flow with dagre for top-down or left-right auto-layout of the process tree.
Create custom node types in React Flow: 'process', 'network', 'file', 'target-highlight'.
In the Inspector Panel, display details based on the selected node.
Implement a mock data graph of explorer.exe -> winword.exe -> cmd.exe -> malware.exe (with connections to IP and File).
DO NOT use generic centered App layouts. Remove default App.css styles that center text.
Follow 'Grid Borders' surface strategy: exposed skeletons, thin borders, no fluffy shadows.
Ensure all interactive components and key text fields have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Use appropriate generous padding inside panels, but maintain high density for data grids.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, etc.
Always include data-testid on interactive elements.
